knowledge_graph.title: Lawyers for Justice P.C.
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Lawyers for Justice, PC, is a first-class employment law firm that has been tirelessly fighting for workers’ rights in California for over a decade. Empowered by 25 employment lawyers, this accredited law firm has obtained millions of dollars in settlement claims on behalf of California workers. Lawyers for Justice represents clients in class action lawsuits involving all types of employment and labor law issues -- wrongful termination, unpaid wages, hostile work environment, and other related litigation. If you were unfairly laid off or wrongfully terminated, you may be owed compensation. You could be entitled to unpaid wages if your layoff was based on prohibited discrimination. Contact Lawyers for Justice today for a free consultation."

🛑 ATTORNEY ADVERTISEMENT: Can You Be Fired for Your Religious Beliefs? Know Your Rights!

In California, it is illegal for employers to fire, discriminate, or retaliate against you because of your religious beliefs or practices. Under federal and state laws, your employer must provide reasonable accommodations for your faith, such as time for prayer or religious dress.

If you’ve been wrongfully fired or discriminated against for your religion, Lawyers for Justice, PC can fight for you! 💼⚖️

📞 Call now for a free consultation!
🔗 Learn more: https://calljustice.com/can-you-be-fired-for-your-religious-beliefs/

📢ATTORNEY ADVERTISEMENT: Remote Workers: Can You Sue for Sexual Harassment?

Yes! Even if you work from home, you’re still protected from sexual harassment under California and federal law. Whether it's inappropriate messages, video calls, or a toxic remote work environment, your employer is responsible for ensuring a harassment-free workplace.

If you're experiencing sexual harassment while working remotely, Lawyers for Justice, PC can help you take action. 💼⚖️

📞 Call us today for a free consultation!
🔗 Learn more: https://calljustice.com/can-remote-workers-sue-for-sexual-harassment/

🚨ATTORNEY ADVERTISEMENT: Injured at Work? Know Your Rights!

If you’ve been injured on the job, you may be entitled to workers’ compensation benefits, including medical care, lost wages, and disability payments. Your employer cannot fire or retaliate against you for filing a claim.

If your employer is denying benefits, delaying medical care, or retaliating, Lawyers for Justice, PC is here to fight for you! 💼⚖️

📞 Call us now for a free consultation!
🔗 Learn more: https://calljustice.com/i-was-injured-at-work/
